headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants in a 10-0 shutout victory, led by Dylan Cease's impressive performance. Kazuma Okamoto's 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs propelled the Blue Jays to the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Owen Caissie (Miami Marlins) was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right calf strain, while John King (Miami Marlins) joins him with a left lateral ankle sprain. Other notable injuries include Tim Herrin (Cleveland Guardians) with a left elbow contusion, Ranger Suarez (Boston Red Sox) with a left groin strain, and Marco Raya (Minnesota Twins) with a right shoulder impingement.

The MLB trade market saw several moves, including the New York Mets acquiring Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade, acquiring Woo-Suk Go from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. Other trades included Ryan Degges going from the Philadelphia Phillies to the Cleveland Guardians and Tom Cosgrove moving from the Houston Astros to the Washington Nationals, both for cash considerations.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Dominate Giants in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 10-0 win over the San Francisco Giants, behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease, who pitched 8.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles 9-7 in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 9-7 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Pete Crow-Armstrong leading the charge at the plate. Crow-Armstrong's impressive performance included two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Torkelson Powers Tigers to 6-1 Win Over Athletics**
top_news.summary: Spencer Torkelson led the way with a 3-RBI, 1-HR performance, while Troy Melton earned the win with 5.1 scoreless innings, striking out 9.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Dylan Dodd earning the win. Joey Bart led the Braves' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with a strong team effort leading to the 10-5 final score. Impact hitters for the Braves included Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin, while Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Lane Thomas and Bobby Witt Jr. among the notable hitters for the losing team. Sean Manaea was among the standout pitchers in the game.

top_news.title: **Marlins' Caissie Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right fielder Owen Caissie has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right calf strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
